# llms.txt

StealthEye Agent OS is a public-visible, locked-down build repo for a high-autonomy agent operating system: Mission OS, app-host surfaces, mission-scoped authority, durable workers, MCP/custom apps, signed manifests, Guard decisions, branch-safe CodeOps, CI Repair contracts, receipts, evals, and compliance-ready evidence for authorized online tasks beyond code automation.

Build 2 adds `@stealtheye/agent-registry`. Build 3 adds `@stealtheye/guard`. Build 4 adds `@stealtheye/mission-os`. Build 5 adds `@stealtheye/app-host` for preview-only MCP-style host tools/resources. Build 6 adds `@stealtheye/worker-fleet` for typed worker task, lease, idempotency, retry, status, artifact, receipt, Guard preflight, and Mission OS handoff foundations. Build 7 adds `@stealtheye/codeops` for CodeOps + CI Repair schemas, branch/path safety helpers, patch plans, file-change contracts, verification plans, CI log classification, repair planning, rerun eligibility, PR evidence, and Guard/Worker Fleet preflight adapters. Build 8 adds `@stealtheye/browserops` for fixture-only browser sessions, page observations, evidence refs, action policies, action plans, Guard preflight, and Worker Fleet handoff. Build 9 adds `@stealtheye/receipts-replay` for receipt events, evidence refs, receipt bundles, timelines, replay packets, verification packets, final reports, and deterministic integrity digests.

## Orient quickly

1. Read `AGENTS.md` for operational rules, commands, and hard stops.
2. Read `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/AUTONOMY_MODEL.md`, `docs/CODEOPS.md`, `docs/CI_REPAIR.md`, `docs/WORKER_FLEET.md`, `docs/APP_HOST.md`, `docs/MISSION_OS.md`, `docs/AGENT_REGISTRY.md`, `docs/CUSTOM_APPS.md`, `docs/SECURITY.md`, `docs/WORKFLOWS.md`, `docs/EVALS.md`, `docs/RECEIPTS.md`, and `docs/REPLAY.md`.
3. Inspect package `src/*` and package tests for Build 2-9 implementation.
4. Treat issue #1 as canonical planning context.
5. Keep public/private boundaries intact. Never add secrets, production endpoints, customer data, private OAuth clients, cloud/account details, production tokens, live write APIs, live queue credentials, money movement, production deploy automation, live GitHub mutation, live CI reruns, live replay execution, or sensitive runbooks.

## Verification commands

```bash
pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
node scripts/stealtheye-build.mjs scripts/phases/build-009-receipts-replay.mjs --check
```
